steps.title: ASTERIA DEFENSE COMMAND
steps.text:
Enemy drones have breached our airspace.
Sentinel-7, you are our last line of defense.
Take control of the cannon. Protect the outpost.

steps.title: 1 / 7  •  AIM
steps.text:
Drag to aim your cannon.
Desktop: move the mouse over the battlefield.

steps.title: 2 / 7  •  FIRE
steps.text:
Hold FIRE to shoot.
Desktop: hold the left mouse button. Hit the practice drone.

steps.title: 3 / 7  •  RELOAD
steps.text:
Reload when your magazine is empty.
Try Reload / R now, or fire the six demonstration rounds.

steps.title: 4 / 7  •  AUTOMATIC DEFENSE
steps.text:
Build automatic defenses to protect your base.
Select a slot, then buy a Machine Gun.

steps.title: 5 / 7  •  WATCH THE FLANKS
steps.text:
Enemy attacks can come from multiple directions.
Watch the marked approach. Help your turret with the cannon.

steps.title: 6 / 7  •  UPGRADE
steps.text:
Upgrade your defenses to survive stronger attacks.
Select a turret, then Upgrade. Build and upgrade at normal speed. Use Pause if you need a break.

steps.title: 7 / 7  •  DEFEND OUTPOST ALPHA
steps.text:
Survive the attack. Keep your base standing.
Live defense: five waves, fresh normal supply.
Place defenses, then tap Launch wave.
